_comment: Synthetic /v1/metrics/llm time-series. mockBackend matches by pathname fragment, so this same body answers every metricsType the page requests (RPM / Success Rate / token counts / latency / TTFT / TPOT). Shape per src CharWrapper.MetricsSingleResponse: { metricsType, data:[{date:unix,value}] }. data MUST be a non-empty array of {date,value} — page.tsx injectEmptyData does res.data.length / res.data[0].date / unshift, and CharWrapper handleResponse does res.data.map; a {} or missing data here throws into the error boundary (proven by mutation test). Timestamps/values are fabricated.
